searchLandscape.informationGain: The official results separately establish the current policy target, meeting calendar, weekly mortgage reference and lock conditions. They do not combine these into a Gulf Coast purchase workflow that preserves the same loan assumptions before and after an announcement, includes taxes and insurance, and compares seller proceeds. The refresh supplies that workflow without assigning a cause to a weekly rate move or predicting the meeting.
